## Summary

<!-- Jelaskan perubahan ini dalam 2-3 kalimat. APA yang berubah dan KENAPA. -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — Fitur baru
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — Refactor (tidak ada fitur baru / bukan bug fix)
- [ ] `perf` — Peningkatan performa
- [ ] `test` — Tambah atau update test
- [ ] `docs` — Update dokumentasi
- [ ] `chore` — Config, deps, CI/CD, tooling
- [ ] `style` — Formatting, whitespace (no logic change)

## Area

- [ ] Auth / Login
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Admin Consumer (`/v2/admin-consumer`)
- [ ] Admin Provider (`/v2/admin-provider`)
- [ ] Authority (`/v2/authority`)
- [ ] API / Services layer
- [ ] UI Components
- [ ] Data Transfer
- [ ] Contracts / Policy
- [ ] Datasets
- [ ] Audit / Compliance
- [ ] Infra / Docker / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit message mengikuti Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`)
- [ ] Tidak ada `console.log` yang tertinggal
- [ ] TypeScript tidak ada error baru
- [ ] Build berjalan tanpa error (`npm run build`)
- [ ] PR title mengikuti format: `type(scope): description`
